profile.headline: Software Engineer | Backend Systems & Integrations | Ruby on Rails | PostgreSQL | Product-Oriented
profile.summary:
Software Engineer passionate about building technology that makes a difference

My path to software engineering wasn't traditional, but it's given me a unique perspective. After transitioning into tech through Merit America's Java program, I joined Systemware as a Solutions Architect, where I got to work on their Content Cloud ECM platform. I built custom solutions and features for major clients like Kroger and CoreLogic, helping them streamline their content management processes.

At Merit America, I was focused on developing our learner platform and internal tools. It's incredibly rewarding to build software that directly impacts people's career transitions and helps our team operate more effectively. My background in sales and management has been invaluable – I understand what users actually need and can translate business requirements into technical solutions.

What drives me is creating technology that serves a purpose beyond just functioning well. Whether I was architecting enterprise solutions at Systemware or building platforms that democratize access to tech careers now, I'm motivated by the opportunity to use my technical skills to make a meaningful impact.
I'm always eager to take on new challenges and continue growing as an engineer while contributing to missions I believe in.

- Admitted to Merit America, a highly-selective learning program, following rigorous assessment of technical acumen, interpersonal skills, and professional aptitude.
- Completed hands-on coursework focused on Java and Web development, including methodologies such as Agile, 12 Factor, Git, Design Patterns, and AWS Deployment.
- Developed leadership & professional skills for future career advancement in the software development field.

positions.title: Event & Brand Partnership Manager
positions.description: Coordinate and manage all domestic & international events for the fastest growing sports nutrition company in the industry and managed and created marketing strategies with business partners.

positions.title: Certified Personal Trainer
positions.description:
- Design personalized programs for clients that were fun and goal achieving.
- Lead training staff in sales and mentor other staff members. 
- Maintain a clean and professional facility for members and deliver excellent customer service. 
- Network with the local community and businesses to build my business and to conduct presentations.

positions.title: Store Manager
positions.description:
- Manage store team of 30+, including 6 assistant managers and part-time clerks to meet company standards and policies. 
- Weekly paperwork including: P&L Explanations, Invoice Research, Sales Tracking Reports, Merchandise Reports, Time & Pay Reports, and all files on employees.
- Train all staff members and conduct performance reviews once a month to determine eligibility for promotion. 
- Handle all documentation of violations of company policies including, reprimands, written warnings, and termination.
- Continuous coaching and mentoring of employees by following up and giving direct and immediate feedback.
